chunks: And by his chain, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who was ignorant of shortening his hair or shaving it, until he departed from Mina. He (peace be upon him) said: 'So let him return to Mina until he shaves his hair there or shortens it, and upon the Sarurah (one performing Hajj for the first time) is that he should shave.'

key_terms.الصَّرُورَةِ: The Sarurah, one who performs Hajj for the first time
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a location near Mecca where key Hajj rituals occur

ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if he forgets to shave or cut his hair before leaving Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the procedural requirement for completing the Hajj rites, emphasizing that the act of shaving or shortening hair must be performed within the precincts of Mina to be valid. It further distinguishes the obligation for the *Sarurah* (first-time pilgrim) to shave completely, reflecting the scholarly consensus on the completeness of the ritual act. This ruling underscores the importance of adhering to the specific locations and actions prescribed during the days of Tashriq.
